text:
- United Kingdom generated £213.6k revenue TW, representing 88.9% of total sales across all countries.
- Total revenue across all countries reached £240.2k TW, declining 15.5% WoW from £284.4k LW.
- United Kingdom revenue fell 17.3% WoW, while EIRE revenue grew 48.8% WoW to £10.5k TW.
- Germany achieved £4.6k revenue TW with a 24.9% WoW increase, though representing only 1.9% of total sales.
- United Kingdom processed 502 orders TW across 113,398 units, significantly outpacing EIRE with 15 orders and Germany with 9 orders.
- EIRE sold 4,238 units TW while Germany sold 3,247 units TW, with total unit sales reaching 126,750 units across all countries.
- Total orders placed TW reached 542, with United Kingdom accounting for 92.6% of order volume.
